title: Square of the Bool-to-$\pm 1$ embedding
statement: For every Boolean value $b$, the image $\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(b)$ under the map sending $\mathtt{false}$ to $1$ and $\mathtt{true}$ to $-1$ satisfies $\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(b)\cdot\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(b) = 1$; that is, this $\pm 1$-valued quantity squares to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: b is an arbitrary Boolean value
